name: Ontology
question: What does the paper assume about the nature of the reality it studies, as stated by the authors or as their framing implies?

labels.name: realist
labels.definition: Reality exists independently of observers and can be measured objectively; variables, causes and effects are real.

labels.name: critical realist
labels.definition: A real world with causal mechanisms exists, but is known only partially and through social and theory-laden accounts; layered (real, actual, empirical).

labels.name: relativist / constructionist
labels.definition: Reality is socially constructed: multiple realities shaped by meaning, language and interaction.

labels.name: pragmatist
labels.definition: Reality is what works in practice; the research question and its usefulness come before metaphysical commitments.

labels.name: not stated
labels.definition: Neither stated by the authors nor clear from the framing.
